audience: restaurant managers who check schedules, open shifts and time punches in 7shifts

useCases.title: See who works at a location
useCases.text: List the locations, then list the shifts of one location for a date range. List the employees to see their roles and departments.

useCases.title: Review time punches
useCases.text: List the clock-in and clock-out records, filtered by approval state or clock time. Open one time punch to read its details.

useCases.title: List active employees by department
useCases.text: List the departments and roles, then list the active employees. Read one employee's assignments to see their locations and roles.

useCases.title: Check the company setup
useCases.text: Read the company plan status, expiry and start-of-week setting. List the reasons used to deactivate an employee.
